Battery optimization is already ignored. Confirm the background allow-list setting below.
Battery optimization is still enabled. Open system settings, then complete the manufacturer allow-list setting below.
VIVO: Settings → Battery → Background high power usage → Portal → Allow.

Xiaomi/Redmi (MIUI/HyperOS): Settings → Battery & performance → App battery saver → Portal → No restrictions. Also enable Autostart (Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Portal → Autostart) and lock the Portal card in Recents.
Huawei: Settings → Apps & services → App launch → Portal → Disable automatic management and allow background activity.
In system settings, find Portal battery or background settings. Allow background activity, disable battery restrictions, and add Portal to the allow-list.
